test_title: PYST 18: Selection Post (Higher Secondary Level) - Quant (Held On 30 Jun, 2023 Shift 2)
subject: maths
question: At what rate per annum will the simple interest on Rs. 550 be Rs.33 in 3 years?
solution:
**Given:**

Principal = Rs.550

Simple interest (S.I) = Rs.33

Time (T) = 3 years

**Formula used:**

Rate (R) = (S.I × 100)/P × T

**Calculation:**

Rate (R) = (S.I × 100)/P × T

⇒ (33 × 100)/(550 × 3)

⇒ 2%

**∴ The correct answer is 2%.**
